verdict.summary: The 4-wave hardening campaign converged clean at the blocking tier: deterministic gates are GREEN (vitest 1872/0, PHP 2714/0, NF525 CHAIN OK confirmed live via fiscal:verify-chain --all, frozen 15/15 — the only frozen-zone touch is the owner-signed LOCK_ZREPORT_REFUND_NETTING ZReportService block, with the baseline SHA re-blessed). Zero new P0/P1 were introduced by V1-V4, so the campaign achieved "tout validé" at the tier that matters: CI green plus the targeted weak points (post-Z refund netting, double-PAID race, z-membership detector cron-wiring, auto-86 dedup) fixed or managed. It is not a literally-zero-issue release: two sub-P1 edges were introduced and are managed/documented — P2 (z-membership cron can false-page on legitimately-counted orders modified post-auto-close, a detect-only heuristic) and P3 (refund mirror nets into scalar total_tva but not total_by_tax_rate, an internal divergence that is dormant under V1's 0% VAT and explicitly flagged at LOCK line 43). The three pre-existing deferrals (broadcast_completed_at orphan marker, kiosk menu-backstop polling, F1 PricingService TVA frozen+dormant) remain owner-gated future-cycle items, not failures and not blockers for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne. Verdict: GO — clean convergence at the P0/P1 tier with two low-severity, documented, dormant-under-V1 edges.
